title: Chapter 957
text:
Army Commander's Special Machinery Factory …

Many silver-white workbenches were lined up neatly. Dozens of multi-functional mechanical arms extended from the base of each workbench and were being assembled at the same time. The entire room was filled with the sound of parts fitting together. Beside the workbenches were many assembly lines, and the other mechanical equipment was waiting to be processed.

Han Xiao walked slowly in the busy workshop with his hands behind his back. The Mechanical Force he released was like a dense spider web, connecting all the workbenches like countless extended limbs. He was multitasking and building many machines at the same time.

The current machinery construction was already very convenient. The efficiency of multithreading was directly related to one's intelligence. If he did not use an assembly line, Han Xiao could also modify a large number of machines at the same time and turn them into players. That was, the modification progress bar of these machines would be loading at the same time.

These workbenches were extremely versatile high-level machinery manufacturing platforms, and they had been modified by Han Xiao. To a Mechanic, the workbenches were also a type of equipment that increased their own machinery manufacturing ability. At Han Xiao's level, he would naturally use the good stuff.

Han Xiao arrived in front of one of the workbenches. This was where the Divine Mechanical Throne was being built. At this time, the last component had been assembled, and the mechanical arm was currently being painted and spitting out cooling mist, which was white and cold.

Waving his hand to disperse the fog, Han Xiao carefully sized up the Divine Mechanical Throne in front of him. This was a black throne made of alloy, and its surface was filled with mechanical patterns. It was squarish and well-defined, and one could tell that it was very ugly just by looking at it.

Fortunately, Han Xiao had added the Nano Transfiguration Technology, which had the ability to enlarge, shrink, and adjust itself. It could perfectly fit any shape. The appearance was similar to the floating throne he had built in the past, but the technology inside was different. In the past, the floating throne only had the effect of showing off, but this one had an attribute bonus. Furthermore, it was exclusive to everyone.

[Divine Mechanical Throne – Black Star]

Item Type: Unique Bonus Equipment

Item Level: 300

Quality: Orange (Legendary)

Main Materials: 8th Generation Black Star Alloy, Mithril, 15th Generation Nano Shaped Particles

Energy Core: Light Modified Stable Psionic Reactor

Basic Stats: Durability 500,000/500,000, Defense 7,800, Shield 1,500,000/1,500,000

Effect 1: [Mechanical Sense Magnification] — 1.1x Total Machinery Affinity

Effect 2: [Aura Enhancement] — Increases deterrence and affects all targets that see you. If the target is 30 levels lower than you, all their attributes will temporarily decrease by 10%.

Effect 4: [Cool] – + 750 CHA

Note: As long as you're handsome, that's it.

"Not only can it act cool, but it also has bonuses. What a pretentious divine artifact." Han Xiao stroked the Divine Mechanical Throne, feeling the cold metallic sensation. He could not bear to part with it.

In the future, if I were to bring this thing out to fight, those who didn't know would think that I was full of arrogance. This was more in line with my cold and mysterious temperament!

After experimenting with the actual effect, Han Xiaoxin put it away with satisfaction. He then looked at the other workstations.

Most of the workstations were updating and strengthening the backup Mech Legion in the inventory, improving the technology to the level of a Divine Throne Mechanic, giving them new performance bonuses. Another portion of the workstations were building new machines, many of which were blueprints of the Tyracles Legacy.

The Tyracles Legacy was a new talent that could be chosen for the level 300 Promotion. This race had a deep understanding of mechanical technology and had many unique and unique machines. When Han Xiao completed his Promotion, he had unlocked the level 300 blueprints.

Some of the blueprints were useful to him now, adding dozens of useful new machines to his Mech Legion. According to their different functions, he had expanded many new units, including many new models of mechanical soldiers.

The Universe Walker was a Tyracles special mechanical soldier. It was purple and green and had a triangular horse-helmet-like head. It was skinny and had a skeletal body. It used biochemical implant technology, and a large number of special nano-biochemical tendons and strengthening fluid were stored in the muscle module under the outer armor. After entering battle, the strengthening fluid would be injected, and the muscles would swell, turning from a bamboo pole into a muscular man's body.

Furthermore, this type of machine had a special ability. It had two stages of transformation. The first was overclocking, which gave it an extremely strong explosive power and an all-around boost. The second was berserk, which was greatly strengthened on the basis of overclocking. At the same time, it could release a special distortion force field. It was very well-rounded in both close and long-range combat. After practical testing, it was discovered that the Universe Walker could defeat most machines with the same bonuses. Its basic performance was one of the best, making it a good line-resistant soldier.

Han Xiao now had a few more Apostle slots. He chose the Universe Walker with the best basic stats and turned it into an Apostle Weapon. Originally, he wanted to call it 'Purple Muscle Tyrant', but after thinking about it, it seemed a little overpowered.

Giving an Apostle Weapon a name was like giving a child a name. Han Xiao pondered for a while before naming it 'Purple Sky Spirit' according to the name format of mechanical life forms. He planned to bring it back to the mechanical civilization and let it give birth to children.

Other than that, there were many other good things in the Tyracles Legacy blueprints. For example, a physical missile equipped with precise hyperdrive guidance. The ammunition was a special high-energy polymer that had extremely strong corrosive and penetrative effects. It was very effective against battleship shields and could be used in space battles. If it encountered a battleship that was not equipped with dimensional anchors or force field interference, the missile could even directly jump over the shield and blast into the spaceship, causing direct damage.

There was also an interesting Star Series device that could create a path to guide and focus the energy of a Star, indirectly causing a Star Destroyer level attack. However, what Han Xiao was more concerned about was a Star Energy Concentrator under this series. Its effect was to collect a large amount of Star material and condense it into a portable device through space technology. Furthermore, it would not affect the reaction of the Star inside the device, thus creating a 'moving Star'.

Other than supplying energy and guiding attacks, this device could also release material from other locations to form a new natural Star. The size of the Star was determined by the amount of material, which was equivalent to helping the Star move.

In the legacy knowledge, the Saint Tyracles people used this method to multiply Stars. After the duplication was completed, they would fill the new Star with dust clouds and material to increase its volume. This way, they would create a natural Star with much higher efficiency than man-made products.

What Han Xiao was more concerned about was the extension function of the Star Energy Concentrator. If this thing was released on someone else's face, would it not be a portable Star Bomb? Its destructive power would probably not be much weaker than a Primordial Psionic Bomb. Furthermore, there was no pollution problem, making it convenient to kill and steal.

…

While Han Xiao was busy modifying the machinery, Sylvia was carrying out the education plan. The first step was to announce to the entire Star Field that the army was starting to develop education.

Ever since Han Xiao defeated the Tyrant, many galactic residents had been paying attention to his movements. They felt that Black Star would make a big move after obtaining the position of being the strongest in the Star Field.

As soon as this announcement was made, a large number of citizens in the Shattered Star Ring became excited. Just the name of the Star Field's top Beyond Grade A Super starting an education plan would attract a large number of people.

The plan was to first prepare to open a few dozen schools in the Godora Star System, and Blue Star was an important pilot area.

Blue Star was developing rapidly. As soon as Nero walked out of the spaceship, he felt that Black Star City had become much more unfamiliar. Compared to when he left, it had changed too much.

"I'm home …"

Nero calmed himself down and returned home. However, he realized that Bennett had gone on a business trip recently, and only his mother was at home.

Because Han Xiao had given him a break, Nero spent the next few days eating, drinking, and having fun, making him extremely happy.

"This is heaven!"

On the balcony of the high altitude villa, Nero sat on a small stool with his legs crossed and a cup of ice cream in his hands. He happily drank with a straw and enjoyed the scenery of the city.

In the Black Star Corps, he did not have any status and could only passively accept the arrangements. However, here, he was the son of the planet's leader, and it would not be an exaggeration to say that he was the young master. As long as he did not break the law, he could have almost anything he wanted … although he only asked his bodyguard to buy him a cup of ice cream.

Zi zi zi!

At this time, the screens of a few buildings outside lit up and played the same piece of news.

"According to reports, the Black Star Corps announced the establishment of a Super Academy in Blue Star yesterday in an effort to find more talents. Federation President Bennett met with the executive principal of the Black Star Super Academy and gave an important speech …"

A live broadcast was shown on the screen, and a press conference was in progress. At the venue, Bennett and Lagi's remote projections were sitting opposite each other and chatting in front of countless reporters. This was a high-level meeting room in the Government Affairs Building, which was also in Black Star City. Nero looked up and could see the Government Affairs Building. It seemed that Bennett had returned from a business trip.

"I represent the people of Blue Star to thank the Black Star Corps for their generosity." In the screen, Bennett had a smile on his face and used official words to express his attitude.

Lagi remained silent and nodded. The official beside him passionately said, "Blue Star is the home planet of His Excellency Black Star, and His Excellency Black Star is very willing to help develop his home planet. The people of Blue Star are all our brothers and sisters."

After being taught a lesson time and time again, Lagi was forbidden from speaking in public. Han Xiao had specially found a cheerful secretary to act as his interpreter.

Nero focused on the screen. He had grown up watching news about Bennett. Every time he saw his father on the screen, he could not help but become more focused.

Looking at Bennett on the screen, Nero suddenly realized that the wrinkles on Bennett's face seemed to have increased, and the white hair on his temples had also increased.

"Father is getting old …"

Nero pursed his lips, and an unknown emotion spread in his heart. The happiness of the holiday gradually disappeared, and it was replaced by a feeling of not being able to study.

After traveling in the universe, Nero's experience had increased a lot, and he slowly became more intelligent. He also had a vague understanding of the situation of Blue Star and Bennett's painstaking efforts. The concept of responsibility gradually formed in his heart.

After hesitating for a while, Nero stuffed the remaining ice cream into his mouth and returned to his room. He unwillingly took out a mechanical theory book from his bag and read it with a bitter expression.

After reading it for a while, he naturally immersed himself in it.

Although he thought that he was unwilling, after studying for a long time, his interest in machinery had already been nurtured. He could not resist, so he learned to enjoy it.

…

"Set up a school?"

Seeing the announcement from the Black Star Corps, Sorokin could not help but fall into deep thought. He walked to the window, looked at another spaceship leaving the Bloodshed Land headquarters, and lightly shook his head.

After Heber's defeat, the negative effects had gradually appeared. His reputation had collapsed, and the unity of the Bloodshed Land had been shaken. During this period, talents had already started to leave the Bloodshed Land. Every few days, someone would choose to leave the Bloodshed Land. They should have been suppressed with an iron fist, but the Tyrant remained in seclusion, and the upper echelons did not take action either.

The Black Star's education program was, in Sorokin's eyes, turning influence into actual support from the people. It was unprecedented, and the Bloodshed Land had fallen to the bottom. The contrast was extremely strong.

Under such circumstances, Sorokin did not have any good ideas. He could only keep a low profile and temporarily stop attacking the Black Star Corps' businesses. He was prepared to wait for this period of time to pass before doing anything else.

Di di di!

At this time, his communicator suddenly rang. Sorokin picked it up and saw that it was a call from Manison.

"Your Excellency Mecha Empire, what's the matter?"

"What business do you want to know about the Black Star Corps' businesses? Give me a list."

Sorokin was stunned. "What do you mean?"

"I'll do you a favor," Manison said calmly.

"I understand. You want to hack into the Black Star Corps' database?" Sorokin's eyes flashed, and he was rather surprised. Was he not afraid of becoming enemies with the Black Star?

"Your actions were also instructed by me. The Radiant Federation asked me to thoroughly investigate the Black Star Corps' database, so I'll take this opportunity to help you," Manison said calmly.

"Not only that," Sorokin narrowed his eyes and joked. "Are you feeling pressured by the rise of Black Star?"

"Don't ask about things that you shouldn't ask." Manison was unmoved.

"Hehe, I understand. I'll send you the list later. If you can really get some insider information, it will be very helpful to my operation."

"Okay." Manison nodded and hung up.

In reality, the Radiant Federation did not ask him to hack into the Black Star Corps' database. This was what Manison had suggested.

Helping Sorokin was just a bonus. More importantly, he wanted to test the strength of the Black Star again. Instead of fighting, he wanted to spar with him in the virtual world.

One of the important reasons for doing this was because he knew that Black Star had been worshipped by the Machinery Faith. In Manison's mind, Black Star had officially turned from a junior with potential to a competitor.

After a few interactions, Manison knew that Black Star was not someone who was willing to remain stagnant. As long as he obtained the faith of the Machinery Faith, he would endlessly want more. Manison was not prepared to sit back and watch Black Star take away the believers. Being indifferent to his own interests was not within his scope of consideration.

Since the conflict of interests was unavoidable, Manison did not plan to continue watching from the sidelines.

Of course, he did not think that Black Star was so easy to kill, and he did not plan to kill anyone himself.

Manison's goal was to completely suppress Black Star in terms of machinery and show the world. His method was like how Han Xiao attacked the Tyrant, damaging Han Xiao's reputation.

This way, the believers of the Machinery Faith who worshipped the strong would not flow to Black Star, and the entire universe would know.

I, the Mecha Empire, am still the father of all mechanics!
